0022600178.text: The Memphis Grizzlies, 6-0 and first in the Southwest and the West, host the Indiana Pacers in their eighth game of the season, riding a six-game winning streak with a 2-0 home record and a 4-0 road mark, though Quinten Post and Scotty Pippen Jr. are both out. Indiana is 2-5 and has lost four straight, including an 0-3 home record, sitting 12th in the East and 3.5 games back in the Central, with Aaron Nesmith, Andrew Nembhard, Ben Sheppard, Ivica Zubac, Johnny Furphy, Kelly Oubre Jr., Larry Nance Jr., Obi Toppin, Pascal Siakam, T.J. McConnell and Tyrese Haliburton all unavailable. The teams have not met yet this season, and Memphis won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, most recently a 125-106 win in Indianapolis on March 1, 2026.
